sens_en: to give, to deliver, to see off
origine_fr: En bas, 辶, la marche ; dessus, 丷 sur 天, qui ne disent ni le sens ni le son. C'est envoyer. Accompagner quelqu'un, faire partir une chose : raccompagner, livrer, offrir.
origine_en: Below, 辶, walking; on it, 丷 over 天, which give neither meaning nor sound. It means to send. Walking someone on their way, sending something off: to see off, to deliver, to give.
